thread:
lina: morning all, brand-new hire here. trying to flip a staging flag and run e2e but i don't have ff-admin or the sa key. who do i bug? :wave:

infra-bot: Access helper: please open onboarding form https://redwood.internal/onboard-access and include project, flag id, and desired TTL for keys. Expected response: 4-8 hours.

sam: welcome lina! quick path: people-ops for group, devtools for SA key, infra for any console role gaps. if you post the flag id i can pre-approve a JIT once groups look good.

lina: flag is `search.model_canary_v3`, project `search-realtime`. tried form but got "missing provisioning group".

people-ops: New hire provisioning note: auto-grouping sometimes lags. @micaela is out, pinging @devops. I'll add lina to `console-jit` now.

devtools: adding context — for e2e we prefer short-lived SA keys with scoped roles: `inference.invoker`, `storage.objectViewer`. we create the key and stash it in vault at `secret/data/onboard/<alias>`. what TTL do you need?

lina: 8h please. also i'd like to add a short flag description so others know the test plan. who owns the metadata?

sam: flag metadata lives in infra/feature-flags repo. submit a one-line PR with owner alias and experiment link. I can review.

people-ops: group membership updated for lina.

infra-bot: JIT request created: JIT-90342 for lina, target role: `ff-admin`, note: "Temp admin to validate search.model_canary_v3 per ticket ENG-7421". Awaiting approval.

devtools: SA key created: alias `sa-lina-e2e`, roles applied, TTL 8h. Vault path `secret/data/onboard/lina/sa-key`. rotational policy attached.

lina: received the vault path and can access it. JIT approved by sam. thank you all! one last thing — where are the logs for who toggled the flag? want to audit after the run.

sam: toggles are logged in console audit trail and also forwarded to `#eng-audit` webhook. you can cross-check the audit id from the toggle UI.

lina: perfect. opening a tiny PR to add the flag description now. thanks everyone for the quick help :tada:
